title: Summer Undergraduate Research Fellowships (SURF) 2027
institution: California Institute of Technology (Caltech), Student-Faculty Programs
about: Caltech's Summer Undergraduate Research Fellowships (SURF) pair undergraduates with Caltech mentors for summer research. The 2027 application opens November 1; applications and two recommendation letters are due February 22, and awards are announced April 1.
requirements: Two confidential letters of recommendation, one from a faculty member, due with the application
International students can take part on the Caltech campus; JPL placements are limited to U.S. citizens and permanent residents
The prospective Caltech mentor completes a separate evaluation

upskill.name: AI for Research & Information Synthesis
why: Field "Science and engineering research" → objective "Use AI to explore, organize, and structure information collected from multiple documents or professional sources."

Description "pair undergraduates with Caltech mentors for summer research" → objective "Summarize long or complex materials while preserving the main arguments, evidence, conclusions, and important contextual details."
